text:
jordan_sales: heads up — Enterprise prospect (HealthSys) wants an enterprise commit. Mixed traffic: interactive chat + on-demand embeddings for search. Asking for sizing guidance + which reserved vs burst strategy to recommend. Peak they quoted: 120 rps chat (avg 800 tokens), 60 rps embeddings (1k vectors batch). Need latency p95 < 350ms for chat. Any quick runbook?

zoe_runtime: @jordan_sales ok can do quick sketch. main questions: are chat and embeddings on same model family or separate? do they require single-tenant GPUs or ok with shared dedicated? also any regulatory notes (HIPAA) so we can recommend Private/Dedicated?

jordan_sales: they said chat uses a 70B quantized variant, embeddings use smaller 2B quantized model. HIPAA required, so they'd prefer Dedicated or Private. Preference is Dedicated with reserved capacity if pricing works.

mike_infra: given HIPAA + dedicated: plan for headroom. rough math: chat 120 rps * 800 tokens = 96k tokens/s. embeddings 60 rps * 1536 token-equivalent (embedding cost) ~ 92k tokens/s equivalent. total ~188k tokens/s. depending on perf profile of 70B quantized, a single reserved GPU (A800/80GB) might do ~4k tokens/s for chat workload; so naive reserve ~47 GPUs to hit sustained. but we should use batching and KV caching to drop effective load.

san_mlops: +1 on caching. if they can accept prefix caching for common prompts and 8-16 token cold start amortization we often see 20-40% token reduction. also switch embeddings to batched 32 -> reduces per-vector overhead. runbook: reserve baseline for steady-state (e.g., 60% of forecast) and allow burst credits for spikes. recommend: reserve 30 GPUs, allow 15 GPUs burst credits + autoscale to 50 as safety.

amy_account: pricing note: reserved 30 GPUs at enterprise rate vs pay-as-you-go for extra burst. customers often ask for a capped monthly burst budget. we can propose 30 reserved + 20 burst credits with soft cap. I'll draft numbers once engineering confirms perf targets. :money_with_wings:

zoe_runtime: latency target p95 <350ms is tight for 70B at those token counts. optimization checklist: quantized kernels (int8/4), fused attention kernels, sequence-length truncation, and smaller context windows for chat. Also set autoscale policy: keep min_replicas = 30, prewarm_slots = 5 per AZ, queue_depth_threshold = 200 -> trigger scale up. fallback plan: model variant fallback to smaller 13B with similar prompt engineering if latency > SLA for >5 minutes.

mike_infra: operational notes: prewarm window should be scheduled during rollout and daily peak. use KV warmup ops: run a small synthetic warmup that populates KV with top 20 prompts. snippet we use for warmup:```
# warmup load (kvm population)
for p in top_prompts.jsonl:
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/serve/warmup -d @p
```

jordan_sales: sounds good. they also sent a security questionnaire — encryption at rest, BYOK, network isolation. do we have standard answers for Dedicated (HIPAA)?

amy_account: I have a template. Dedicated supports KMS integration (customer-managed keys), network isolation via VPC peering + private endpoints, SOC2 + HIPAA BAAs available. I'll attach the template in the deal room.

san_mlops: action items from eng side: 1) run perf sim for their specific prompts (we need a 5–10 minute corpus) 2) produce a cost estimate for reserved 30 + burst 20 GPUs and a capped monthly burst cost 3) draft autoscale policy and fallback plan doc. I can kick off perf sim today if Jordan can get representative prompt trace.

jordan_sales: I'll ask the customer for a 20k msg sample and permission for a short perf run. expected timeline: get sample today, perf run tomorrow, initial numbers by EOD tomorrow. tagging @zoe_runtime @mike_infra for visibility.

deploy-bot: new load-test-job started by san_mlops — job id lt-2024-09-15-17-03 (status: queued).

zoe_runtime: perfect. if perf sim shows each GPU can do better than conservative numbers (e.g., 5k tokens/s) we can reduce reserve. but plan the pricing offering around 30 reserved + capped burst. also include a canary and phased ramp in the rollout plan.

mike_infra: I'll prepare an AZ spread plan and eviction tolerance notes for reserved pool. expect doc in ~6 hours.

amy_account: I'll prepare the contractual language for burst cap and overage rates and attach to the proposal.

jordan_sales: thanks everyone — will update here once I have the sample. :pray:
